info.title: ZKTeco Biometric Integration API
info.description: API documentation for the ZKTeco Biometric Integration system. Manage organizations, devices, and attendance data.

post.description: Authenticate user and get API token.

requestBody.description: Authenticate user and get API token.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/login" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}" \

    -d "email"="admin@example.com" \
    -d "password"="password" \
    -d "device_name"="my-pc"

curl -X POST "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/logout" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

curl -X GET -G "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/me" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

get.description: Get paginated attendance entries for the authenticated user.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://localhost/api/v1/attendance" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

post.description:
Push attendance entries from ZKTeco devices via API.
Requires a valid user token AND a push_token in headers.

requestBody.description:
Push attendance entries from ZKTeco devices via API.
Requires a valid user token AND a push_token in headers.

entries[].branch.description: Branch name (fallback if branch_id not set).

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://localhost/api/v1/attendance/receive" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}" \

    -d "organization_id"="1" \
    -d "device_id"="1" \
    -d "entries[].emp_id"="EMP001" \
    -d "entries[].check_time"="2026-01-15 09:00:00" \
    -d "entries[].real_emp_id"="001" \
    -d "entries[].branch_id"="1" \
    -d "entries[].branch"="HQ"

get.description: Get push history logs for the authenticated user.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://localhost/api/v1/attendance/push-logs" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

get.description: Get a paginated list of employees. Managers only.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, badge, or card number.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://localhost/api/v1/employees" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

post.description: Create a new employee record. Managers only.

requestBody.description: Create a new employee record. Managers only.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://localhost/api/v1/employees" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}" \

    -d "organization_id"="1" \
    -d "mdb_user_id"="1001" \
    -d "name"="John Doe" \
    -d "badge_number"="EMP001" \
    -d "card_no"="CARD001" \
    -d "department_id"="2" \
    -d "privilege"="0" \
    -d "is_active"="1"

get.description: Get a single employee by ID. Managers only.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://localhost/api/v1/employees/{employee}" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"

put.description: Update an existing employee record. Managers only.

requestBody.description: Update an existing employee record. Managers only.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X PUT "http://localhost/api/v1/employees/{employee}" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}" \

    -d "organization_id"="1" \
    -d "mdb_user_id"="1001" \
    -d "name"="John Doe" \
    -d "badge_number"="EMP001" \
    -d "card_no"="CARD001" \
    -d "department_id"="2" \
    -d "privilege"="0" \
    -d "is_active"="1"

delete.description: Delete an employee record. Managers only.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X DELETE "http://localhost/api/v1/employees/{employee}" \
    -H "0: {"name":"Accept","value":"application\/json","when":[],"except":[]}"
